description:
Retire the item-kind tables in the shared harness and test taxonomy in favour of the package derivation.

## Background

`TestHarness::with_item_kinds` (`crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs`) hand-copies the shipped kinds as `CANONICAL_ITEM_KINDS`, with the `D-[0-9]+` pattern, and `SUITE_TABLES` in `crates/jit/src/test_taxonomy.rs` restates them again. Shared test support derives the shipped kinds from `profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml`. `dev/TESTING.md` documents `with_item_kinds` as a worked example.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `TestHarness::with_item_kinds` and `test_taxonomy` take shipped kinds from the derivation, and neither holds an item-kind literal.
- [hard] REQ-02: Harness tests that use item kinds assert what they asserted before.
- [hard] REQ-03: `dev/TESTING.md` describes the derivation where it describes `with_item_kinds`.
title: Harness and test taxonomy take shipped item kinds from the derivation
